C1-1-0.name: Say it with a phrasal verb
C1-1-0.prompt: Reescribe cada frase con el phrasal verb adecuado, cuidando la posición de la partícula.
items: I can’t stand his attitude any more. (tolerate) → I can’t ______ his attitude any more.
We argued about money and stopped speaking. (quarrel) → We ______ over money.
The meeting has been postponed until Friday. → They’ve ______ the meeting until Friday.
She raised the issue of salaries at the meeting. → She ______ the issue of salaries.
Turn off the lights. (use a pronoun) → Turn ______.
I’ve always admired my grandmother. → I’ve always ______ my grandmother.
answers: I can’t put up with his attitude any more.
We fell out over money.
They’ve put off the meeting until Friday.
She brought up the issue of salaries.
Turn them off.
I’ve always looked up to my grandmother.

C1-1-1.name: Gerund or infinitive?
C1-1-1.prompt: Completa cada frase con la forma correcta (-ing o to + verbo) según el significado.
items: She didn’t lock the door. She forgot. → She forgot ______ (lock) the door.
I have a clear memory of meeting him in 2019. → I remember ______ (meet) him in 2019.
He paused on the way to buy coffee. → He stopped ______ (buy) coffee.
If the app freezes, restart your phone as an experiment. → Try ______ (restart) your phone.
We said no to the offer. → We refused ______ (accept) the offer.
I’m sorry I said that. → I regret ______ (say) that.
answers: She forgot to lock the door.
I remember meeting him in 2019.
He stopped to buy coffee.
Try restarting your phone.
We refused to accept the offer.
I regret saying that.

C1-2-0.name: Object + which verb form?
C1-2-0.prompt: Reescribe cada frase con el verbo indicado y el patrón correcto: objeto + to, verbo base o -ing.
items: My boss said I had to stay late. (make) → My boss ______ late.
They allowed us to use the terrace. (let) → They ______ the terrace.
I’d like you to read the contract first. (want) → I ______ the contract first.
I noticed her. She was crossing the street. (see) → I ______ the street.
They forced him to sign. (passive) → He ______ sign.
We weren’t permitted to take photos. (allowed) → We ______ photos.
answers: My boss made me stay late.
They let us use the terrace.
I want you to read the contract first.
I saw her crossing the street.
He was made to sign.
We weren’t allowed to take photos.

C1-2-1.name: Spotlight it
C1-2-1.prompt: Reescribe cada frase como una frase hendida con what (o all) para destacar la idea clave.
items: The colour caught my eye. → What ______
We need more time. → What ______
She rewrote the entire report. (focus on the action) → What she ______
I only want an apology. (all) → All ______
Her honesty surprised me. → What ______
They cancelled the event. (focus on the action) → What they ______
answers: What caught my eye was the colour.
What we need is more time.
What she did was rewrite the entire report.
All I want is an apology.
What surprised me was her honesty.
What they did was cancel the event.

C1-3-0.name: Article or no article?
C1-3-0.prompt: Completa cada espacio con a, an, the o ningún artículo (—).
items: ___ internet has changed ___ way we work.
She’s studying at ___ university in Manizales. ___ university is famous for engineering.
___ robots are becoming cheaper every year.
It was ___ first time I had seen ___ MRI scan.
He’s ___ only person who understands ___ problem.
___ education is ___ key to reducing inequality.
answers: The internet has changed the way we work.
She’s studying at a university in Manizales. The university is famous for engineering.
Robots are becoming cheaper every year. (no article)
It was the first time I had seen an MRI scan.
He’s the only person who understands the problem.
Education is the key to reducing inequality. (no article before “Education”)

C1-3-1.name: Compress it
C1-3-1.prompt: Reescribe cada frase con una cláusula -ing (o having + participio), manteniendo el mismo sujeto.
items: Because she didn’t know the way, she asked a police officer.
When he opened the envelope, he found a cheque.
After they had finished the survey, they analysed the data.
The report, which shows a clear trend, surprised everyone.
As I was feeling ill, I stayed at home.
She smiled and waved goodbye. (one sentence with an -ing clause)
answers: Not knowing the way, she asked a police officer.
Opening the envelope, he found a cheque.
Having finished the survey, they analysed the data.
The report, showing a clear trend, surprised everyone.
Feeling ill, I stayed at home.
Smiling, she waved goodbye.
